text.tspan: (Optional) skip very low-bitrate files based on overall bitrate.
Current config: greaterThan=0 Mbps (disabled — all files pass through).
Why: Very low-bitrate files are typically trailers,
extras, featurettes, or already heavily compressed
content. Re-encoding HEVC at very low bitrates:
• Produces worse quality than the source
• Wastes GPU encode sessions on tiny files
• NVENC performs poorly near its quality floor
• Output 2 (at or below threshold): mark done without re-encoding
★ CONFIGURE: set greaterThan to 1+ Mbps to skip low-bitrate files like
Delete this node and its comment to remove the check.
File too small/compressed to benefit from HEVC.
